title: Hair is made of dead cells filled with keratin, and melanin colors it
summary: OpenStax says hair is made of dead keratinized cells and gets its color from melanin.
body: OpenStax lists hair among accessory structures of the body covering. Hair is made of dead keratinized cells. Melanin pigments give it color. The chapter review does not give a count of hairs or a rule for cutting them. This card is what hair is made of and why it has color. It is not a claim about baldness.

sources.title: 5.2 Accessory Structures of the Skin, chapter review
